searched: Searched 2026-10-15 for gap-filling records on DeepSeek, ByteDance Seed, Alibaba Qwen/Tongyi, Moonshot AI co-founders, Tencent Hunyuan, Baidu ERNIE and Shanghai AI Laboratory (2023–2026), avoiding the earlier China pass’s failed routes. Primary sources retrieved and used: Alibaba’s FY2026 Form 20-F (SEC EDGAR, through the reader relay because SEC refuses the tool’s user agent; located with EDGAR full-text search), Baidu’s 20-F filings of 28 March 2025 and 17 March 2026 (same route), Alizila (Alibaba) 23 January 2025, ByteDance Seed’s pinned Seed-OSS model card on Hugging Face and its Alignment & Preparedness post of 14 October 2026, Yuxin Wu’s and Shunyu Yao’s personal sites, and Zhou Bowen’s Tsinghua faculty page. Reporting used only where no primary text could be retrieved: MIT Technology Review 2025-01-24 (DeepSeek founding month), Jiemian 2025-02-21 and 2026-03-05, 科创板日报 (Cailian Press) 2025-12-17, 2026-03-05 and 2026-07-24, Caixin Global 2026-04-08 (subscriber article; opening only), The Paper 2025-11-25 and 2026-06-14, 36Kr 2025-11-11, Guancha 2026-07-01. Not retrievable or not usable: DeepSeek gives no founding date or named leaders beyond Liang Wenfeng on any retrieved page; a 17 July 2023 registration date appears only in aggregator or user-uploaded pages (快科技 via ifeng 大风号) and was not used; Seed’s web pages (seed.bytedance.com zh/en, career page) and its Hugging Face organisation page give no founding year; ByteDance made no retrievable announcement of Wu Yonghui’s hire or of Zhu Wenjia’s role; Tencent’s and Baidu’s reorganisations were internal announcements known only through reporting; Baidu’s IR management page (relay) lists only Robin Li and Haijian He; Shanghai AI Laboratory’s site is script-rendered (about page and news pages gave no leadership text); SCMP’s Tencent article is paywalled; Google’s research profile for Yonghui Wu returned 404; Reddit (Moonshot AMA, November 2025) refused retrieval; The Paper’s mobile page was blocked by a WAF (desktop URL worked); a Moonshot HKEX prospectus does not exist publicly (confidential filing reported). Left out: Zhou Chang’s reported 2024 move from Alibaba’s Tongyi team to ByteDance (reporting centres on an employment dispute and compensation); a 2024 The Paper report naming Moonshot co-founders (its subject is personal shareholdings); Alibaba’s March 2026 foundation-model support group (reports differ on its members); Tencent Hunyuan hires below department-head level; ByteDance Seed personnel reports based on an opinion column (澎湃号·湃客); Alibaba’s denial of Zhou Jingren’s resignation (kept only in a qualification); DeepSeek’s reported 2026 financing (capital, not leadership).
